Padang, Sumatera Barat · kos 3 lantai + rooftop3-storey boarding house + rooftop

Kali Serayu Living

TantanganChallenge
Wilayah KDS D di atas tanah lunak, lahan diapit rumah tetangga sehingga fondasi memakai tiang bor. Rancangan awal butuh 52 tiang, dan pemilik menilai fondasinya terlalu besar untuk sebuah kos.Seismic Design Category D on soft ground, with neighbours on both sides, so the foundation uses bored piles. The first design needed 52 piles, and the owner felt that was too much for a boarding house.
SolusiSolution
Studi ulang kelompok tiang dan poer tiga tiang. Poer tepi mengikuti sketsa segi enam arsitek, poer sudut diputar dan digeser agar tiang tetap di dalam batas tanah. Tulangan dibatasi D19 karena D25 langka di Padang, lalu kolom diuji ulang terhadap geser join.A fresh study of pile groups and three-pile caps. Edge caps follow the architect's hexagonal sketch, corner caps are rotated and shifted so every pile stays inside the site boundary. Bars were capped at D19 because D25 is scarce in Padang, and the columns were rechecked for joint shear.
HasilResult
Fondasi turun dari 52 ke 42 tiang. Laporan perhitungan 60 halaman, model struktur Revit lengkap dengan tulangan, set gambar DED, dan bar bending schedule fabrikasi.Foundation reduced from 52 to 42 piles. A 60-page calculation report, a full Revit structural model with reinforcement, a DED drawing set and a fabrication bar bending schedule.

Alur kerjaProcess

Setiap angka di laporan bisa ditelusuri ke sumbernya, dan setiap laporan diperiksa sebelum terbit.Every number in a report traces back to its source, and every report is checked before it is issued.

  1. Data & kriteriaData & criteria

    Gambar arsitektur, data tanah, mutu bahan, dan standar acuan ditetapkan di awal.Architectural drawings, soil data, material grades and governing codes are fixed up front.

  2. Model

    Model analisa di ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE, atau STAAD.Pro sesuai jenis struktur.Analysis model in ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE or STAAD.Pro to suit the structure.

  3. Analisa & desainAnalysis & design

    Gempa, angin, beban bergerak, lalu kapasitas elemen dan fondasi.Seismic, wind and moving loads, then member and foundation capacity.

  4. LaporanReport

    Laporan perhitungan dengan alur rumus yang terlihat dan sumber setiap angka.A calculation report that shows the working and the source of every number.

  5. Gambar & modelDrawings & model

    Gambar struktur dan model Revit untuk koordinasi dengan arsitek dan pelaksana.Structural drawings and a Revit model for coordination with architect and contractor.
